step1_analysis.description: A 3-stage ring oscillator with an NMOS injection switch (XM8) connected between two stages. The switch modulates the oscillator to lock its frequency to exactly half of the injection signal frequency.

paper_reference.title: A 44-W 4.3-GHz Injection-Locked Frequency Divider With 2.3-GHz Locking Range

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit from the supply voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total ≈ 3 * I_stage. I_stage ≈ 0.5 * up * Cox * (W/L) * (VDD - Vbias - |Vth|)^2 = 0.5 * 50u * 10 * (1.8 - 0.4 - 0.42)^2 ≈ 240 uA. Total current ≈ 0.72 mA. Power = 1.8V * 0.72mA = 1.3 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for Sky130 1.8V supply compared to the paper's 0.7V. Higher supply and bias current significantly increase power consumption.

operating_frequency.description: The output frequency of the divider when locked to the input signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_out = f_in / 2. With an injection frequency of 4.3 GHz, the output frequency will be 2.15 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports a 4.3 GHz maximum operating frequency for the input. The output is half of the input frequency.

locking_range.description: The range of input frequencies over which the circuit successfully divides the frequency by exactly 2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Difference between max and min input frequency where division ratio remains exactly 2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Paper reports a 2.3 GHz locking range. In Sky130 at 1.8V, the locking range might be similar or wider due to higher overdrive, but depends heavily on the injection amplitude and Q-factor of the ring oscillator.

division_ratio.description: The ratio of the input injection frequency to the output frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: By design, this topology modulates the ring oscillator twice per cycle, resulting in a divide-by-2 operation.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power consumption, input frequency, output frequency, and verify the division ratio of 2 under a 4.3 GHz injection signal.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Injection-Locked Frequency Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N0 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 LABEL_NET_0 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 LABEL_NET_2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Bias voltages for PMOS active loads to tune free-running frequency
V_bias1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.4
V_bias2 N1 0 0.4
* Injection signal at 4.3 GHz
V_inj LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.9 4.3G)
* Pull-up resistor for open-drain output buffer
R_out VDD LABEL_NET_0 1k

* Initial conditions to kickstart the ring oscillator
.ic v(N0)=1.8 v(N3)=0 v(N4)=1.8

.control
tran 10p 20n

* Measure Power Consumption
meas tran pwr avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=20n
let power_mw = -pwr * 1.8 * 1000
print power_mw

* Measure Output Frequency
meas tran t1 trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=10 targ v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=11
let fout = 1 / t1
print fout

* Measure Input Frequency
meas tran t_in trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 rise=10 targ v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 rise=11
let fin = 1 / t_in
print fin

* Calculate Division Ratio
let div_ratio = fin / fout
print div_ratio

quit
.endc
.end
